subject: Vendor onboarding: invoice enclosure standards & onboarding form clarification
messages:

Subject: Vendor onboarding question: where to send invoices / multi-PO handling

Hi Karthik,

We're getting ready to activate BrightPath as a vendor for Redwood. A couple of questions came up from our AP team as we're filling out your onboarding form:

- Do you prefer vendors to use the portal for invoice submission, or is emailing invoices to an AP inbox acceptable as a long-term pattern?
- We often need to submit a single PDF that covers multiple POs (sometimes 3-5 POs on one invoice) — what is your recommended filename convention and how should we indicate the PO mapping (in the PDF, or a separate CSV)?
- Is there an onboarding form we should complete and return? If so, can we sign electronically?

I've attached a redacted sample invoice and a quick list of our typical line items to give you context.

Can you point us to the preferred path and any do/don't rules for attachments?

Thanks,
Thomas Lee
AP Manager
BrightPath Systems
(attachment: BrightPath_sample_invoice.pdf)
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Thomas Lee <thomas.lee@brightpath.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 16 Oct 2026 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding question: where to send invoices / multi-PO handling

Hi Thomas — thanks for the sample and the clear questions. TL;DR: Portal first, email fallback acceptable with specific conventions. Details below and an onboarding form attached.

Portal vs email
- Preferred: vendor portal (portal.redwood.ai) — it gives us automated PO matching and faster payment. If you can onboard there we’ll prioritize that path.
- Fallback: email to ap@redwood.ai is supported for vendors who can’t use the portal. Use the subject token shown below so our ingest can auto-queue the invoice.

Filename and enclosure rules (email fallback)
- Recommended filename: BRP_INV_<INVOICE#>_<PRIMARY_PO#>_<YYYYMMDD>.pdf
  - Example: BRP_INV_20261001_PO-45321_20261001.pdf
- If a single PDF covers multiple POs, include a cover CSV attachment named BRP_PO_MAP_<INVOICE#>.csv that maps PO -> line ranges. We will not rely on OCR to guess PO numbers.
- Cover CSV header (recommended): invoice_number, invoice_date, vendor_name, po_number, line_start, line_end, line_description, line_total
- Alternate: If you cannot produce a CSV, ensure each PO number is clearly written on the first page of the PDF and repeat the PO list in the email body (comma-separated).

Subject token (please include when emailing)
- Subject should start with: [RDW-AP:BRP] followed by invoice number and date
  - Example subject: [RDW-AP:BRP] INV 20261001 — PO 45321,45322

Onboarding form & signature
- Attached: vendor_onboarding_form_karthik.pdf (fillable). We accept completed PDFs via email or DocuSign. If you prefer DocuSign, I can send a link — we typically use DocuSign for faster enterprise onboarding.

SFTP / API
- If you plan to do high-volume billing, we can provision an SFTP drop or an API token for automated submissions. For that route, loop in marissa_cole@redwood.ai (cc'd) to start the activation checklist.

Other must-haves
- VAT/Tax ID on the invoice header (for non-US vendors).
- One invoice number per invoice file (even if multiple POs are listed).
- For credit memos: include a clear reference to the original invoice number.

Next steps
1) Please complete the onboarding form attached and either return via email or reply here to request DocuSign.
2) Confirm whether you'll use the portal, SFTP, or email fallback.

I'll loop in operations (vanessa) and Marissa for any enterprise exceptions.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Sales Ops
Redwood Inference

Quick clarifying note — Karthik, small operational addendum:
- For multi-PO PDFs we prefer the cover CSV approach. When in doubt, require the vendor to include the PO list in the email body as well so our human ops team can triage faster.
- Also, when provisioning tokens for email ingest, please make sure the vendor domain is whitelisted before live sends; otherwise messages can be routed to a quarantine queue.

Thomas — happy to own the SFTP activation if BrightPath will move to scheduled batch drops (we have a standard activation SLA of 5 business days once we receive the completed form & test file).

Marissa Cole
Director, Revenue Operations
